挺舒服的。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Not only are they bolted to the floor, but
you would look rather silly walking around
with a bar stool.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這些板凳不但被鎖在地上，
而且你扛著一張板凳到處走
看起來也很滑稽。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThe cactus is just another part of this\nwonderfully decorated bar.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n這棵仙人掌只是這間\n裝潢用心的酒吧的一部分。

column2:
[title21][sentence]
After pondering for a moment the
implications of stuffing a cactus in
your pocket, you decide to leave it
where it is.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
你想了一下把仙人掌
塞進口袋會有什麼後果，
決定還是讓它留在原地。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
The rotating mirror ball is the icon
of the trashy discotheque.  You feel right
at home under it's familiar light.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這顆旋轉鏡球是這間
俗氣迪斯可舞廳的招牌。
在它熟悉的光線下，
你感覺特別自在。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The upper dance floor is just large
enough to hold one or two people.
At the moment, there is only one
person up there, and she is not dancing.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
樓上的舞池小得剛好
只能容納一兩個人。此刻
上面只有一個人，而且
她並沒有在跳舞。

column2: [title19][sentence]\nThe trees around the bar add to the decor.\nThey go well with the native rock walls.
column3:
[title19][sentence]
酒吧周圍的樹木增添了
不少氣氛，跟這裡的
原生岩壁相當搭。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThere are several plants hanging beneath the\nbalcony.  They look well cared for.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n陽台下方掛著幾盆植物，\n看起來被照顧得很好。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nAre we getting a little desperate?
column3: [title21][sentence]\n我們是不是有點太心急了？

column2:
[title16][sentence]
The tip of a folded piece of paper
protrudes from the woman's back
pocket.
column3:
[title16][sentence]
一張折疊紙的一角，
從那女人的後口袋裡
露了出來。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
You carefully extract the list from
the woman's pocket.  Fortunately,
she is well anesthetized, and
doesn't notice your thievery.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
你小心翼翼地從那女人的
口袋裡抽出清單。幸好
她醉得不省人事，
沒發現你順手牽羊。

column2:
[title32]ALIEN LIQUOR
Having paid for the bottle of liquor,
you now stash it in your jacket for
safekeeping.
column3: [title32]外星酒\n付了酒錢之後，你把這瓶酒\n藏進外套裡妥善收好。

column2: [title32]CREDIT CHIP\nYou retrieve your credit chip from the bar, hoping\nto find further use for it later.
column3: [title32]信用晶片\n你從吧台拿回信用晶片，\n希望之後還能派上用場。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
You are standing on what must surely be a
maintenance platform above the city.  A
breathtaking view of the city stretches before
you, revealing the bizarre two level structure
in it's entirety.  Apparently, the entire
metropolis was constructed inside an enormous,
inactive volcano cone.  Far below, you see the
glowing magma which warms the city.  Behind
you and beyond the rim of the city, you can see
only ocean.  You pause for a moment in awe of
this engineering marvel, after which you notice
that you are standing almost directly over a large
statue of a beautiful woman.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
你站的地方，想必是俯瞰
城市的一座維修平台。眼前
是令人屏息的城市全景，
展現出這座詭異雙層結構的
全貌。看來，整座城市都是
建在一座巨大的死火山口
內部。遙遠下方，你看到
溫暖著城市的發光岩漿。
你身後、城市邊緣之外，
只有一片汪洋。你駐足片刻，
讚嘆這項工程奇蹟，這才
注意到自己幾乎正站在一座
美麗女子雕像的正上方。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
This is obviously the end of the line
for the elevator.  The doors have
closed, but since you haven't heard
any movement. You assume that it is
waiting for you.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這裡顯然是電梯的
終點站。門已經關上了，
但你沒聽到任何動靜，
猜想它是在等你。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
The rim of the city is obviously the top
of the volcano cone.  The short section
you are standing on has been paved, and
you imagine that it must be a maintenance
platform.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
城市的邊緣顯然就是
火山口的頂端。你腳下這一小段
已經鋪過路面，你猜這裡
應該是個維修平台。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
These probably served some purpose
during construction of the city.  Time and
weather have taken their toll on these
outcroppings, in some cases revealing
the reinforcing steel beneath.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這些東西大概是建城時
派上用場的。歲月與風化
對這些突出物造成了損害，
有些地方甚至能看到
裡頭外露的鋼筋。

column2:
[title21][sentence]
A sharp metal hook protrudes from the
right-most pylon.  The weather has
rusted most of the metal away.
column3:
[title21][sentence]
最右邊的橋墩上突出一個
尖銳的金屬鉤。風吹雨打
讓大部分金屬都鏽蝕了。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
You fishing line dangles from the small
metal hook.  It extends to the base
of a large statue below.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
你的釣魚線垂掛在那個
小金屬鉤上，一路延伸到
下方大雕像的底座。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
A cone of igneous rock surrounds the rim
of the city.  The sunlight washes warmly over
it's pocked blue-purple surface.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
一圈火成岩環繞著
城市邊緣。陽光溫暖地
灑在那坑坑疤疤的
藍紫色表面上。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nYou don't need any pumice.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n你不需要任何浮石。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nTo the east you see a teleporter\nbooth.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n東邊你看到一座\n傳送亭。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
You skillfully tie the fishing line to the metal
hook, then toss the fishing line toward the
large statue below.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
你熟練地把釣魚線
綁在金屬鉤上，然後把線
甩向下方的大雕像。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nAnd undo all your wonderful work?
column3: [title21][sentence]\n把你這番心血都毀了？

column2:
[title20][sentence]
This tall building towers over all the
other buildings.  It looks like the tallest
building in the entire city.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
這棟高樓聳立在所有
建築之上，看起來是
全城最高的一棟。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
If you tie the line to a pylon, it is likely
to slip off over the top.  There is, however,
a sharp hook-like protrusion on the upper right
corner of the right-most pylon.  You could probably
tie the line securely to that.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
如果把線綁在橋墩上，
很可能會從頂端滑掉。不過，
最右邊橋墩的右上角
有個尖銳的鉤狀突起，
或許可以把線牢牢綁在
那上面。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
On the desk you see a pair of monitors,
some papers, a coffee mug, and the stale
remains of a doughnut.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
桌上有兩台螢幕、
一些文件、一個咖啡杯，
還有吃剩、放到不新鮮的
甜甜圈。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The rear wall is carved out of rock, much
like the cell you just escaped from.  One
wall is covered with equipment.  Since this
equipment is unfamiliar to you, and you are
trying to remain undetected, you decide
not to play with it.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
後牆是從岩石鑿出來的，
跟你剛逃出來的牢房差不多。
有一面牆擺滿了設備。
這些設備你完全不熟，
加上你想保持低調，
決定還是別亂碰。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
Apparently the same interior decorator
who chose 'early Mesozoic igneous' decor
for the back wall chose 'art deco' for these
lighting fixtures.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
看來幫後牆選了「早期
中生代火成岩」風格的
那位室內設計師，燈具
則挑了「裝飾藝術」風。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThe panels of white lights keep this room\nextremely well lit.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n這片白光燈板，把房間\n照得非常明亮。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nYou don't have any need for forty feet of\nfluorescent light fixtures.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n你用不著四十呎長的\n日光燈具。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The little bulb dangling from a wire
in the middle of the room is dwarfed
by the light panels on either side.  This
must have been left here by the original
construction crew.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
房間中央用電線垂掛的
小燈泡，在兩側燈板的
對比下顯得微不足道。
這大概是當初的施工人員
留下來的。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nAttempting to steal this little light bulb\nwould accomplish little.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n想偷這顆小燈泡，\n也不會有什麼收穫。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Although you don't see anyone, you hear people.
You decide to be VERY quiet.  If you were
discovered, you might have to explain yourself
to that wonderful doctor.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
雖然你沒看到人，
卻聽到人聲。你決定
「非常」安靜。萬一被發現，
你恐怕得向那位好心的
醫生解釋一番。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nYou don't see any guards, but you\ndecide to stay put and not take any chances.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你沒看到警衛，
但還是決定按兵不動，
不冒任何風險。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
In this extremely well-lit room you see a
desk with a pair of monitors on it.
After a look about, you conclude that
this must be some sort of monitoring station.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這間燈光極亮的房間裡，
有張擺著兩台螢幕的桌子。
環顧四周後，你判斷
這裡應該是某種監控站。

column2:
[title19][sentence]
You pretty much destroyed the latch when
you kicked the grate open.  You shouldn't
have any trouble getting it open again.
column3:
[title19][sentence]
你踹開柵欄時，幾乎
把門閂弄爛了。要再打開
應該不成問題。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
A message engraved on the statue's
hand reads: "You must be at least this 
high to enter the teleporter."
column3:
[title25][sentence]
雕像手上刻著一行字：
「身高需達到此處以上，
才能進入傳送器。」

column2: [title16][sentence]\nYou would look pretty silly carrying this\nthing around with you.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n你扛著這東西到處走，\n看起來會很滑稽。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
This must be the baggage belt.  You have
been wary of these things ever since your
favorite suitcase was eaten by a Rectarian
baggage handler.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這一定是行李輸送帶。
自從你最愛的手提箱
被一個雷克塔星球的
行李搬運工吃掉之後，
你就對這種東西很有戒心。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
That is not a good idea.  It's a safe bet
that anything that goes on that belt
ends up in a black hole somewhere.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這可不是個好主意。
幾乎可以肯定，凡是放上
這條輸送帶的東西，最後
都會掉進某個黑洞裡。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
You have become familiar with devices of
this type.  There is a small note on it which
reads: "Attention transmorphs:  This machine's
gender security system is still active!"
column3:
[title24][sentence]
你已經很熟悉這類裝置了。
上面有張小紙條寫著：
「變體人請注意：這台機器的
性別安控系統仍在運作中！」

column2:
[title22][sentence]
The display show all sorts of status
information about teleporters.  From the
number of lines on the display you gather
there must be many such teleporters.
Too bad they don't list the teleport codes here.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
顯示幕上列出各種
傳送器的狀態資訊。從
顯示的行數看來，這樣的
傳送器數量應該不少。
可惜這裡沒列出傳送代碼。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nThis leads to a long east-west corridor.
column3: [title24][sentence]\n這裡通往一條東西向\n的長廊。

column2:
[title32][sentence]
The pictures show various exquisite
vacation spots.  Can't you just see yourself 
lying on the beach with a Tikillya Earthrise, 
looking for shells.  You decide to stop
daydreaming and do something productive.
column3:
[title32][sentence]
這些照片展示著各種精緻的
度假勝地。你彷彿看到自己
躺在沙灘上，手拿一杯
「提基拉地出」，悠閒地
撿貝殼，決定別再做白日夢，
做點正經事吧。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nThe plants need water, but otherwise\nthey look all right.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n這些植物需要澆水，\n除此之外看起來還好。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
You are overwhelmed by a sudden urge
to gather flowers and place them in
strategically aesthetic spots around the room.
The urge leaves you hoping the gender
bender still works in reverse.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
你突然湧起一股衝動，
想摘些花，巧妙地擺在
房間各個角落當裝飾。
這股衝動讓你不禁
希望性別轉換器還能
反著用一次。

column2:
[title18][sentence]
In this tiny room you see a teleporter,
a strange display on the wall, and a
conveyer belt.  One wall is littered
with pictures.
column3:
[title18][sentence]
這間小房間裡有一座
傳送器、牆上一個奇怪的
顯示幕，還有一條輸送帶。
一面牆上貼滿了照片。

column2:
[title32]BLUB BLUB BLUB
As the elevator descends into the flooded
city, you have a bad feeling.  When the
elevator doors open, you have an even worse
feeling.
column3:
[title32]咕嘟咕嘟咕嘟
電梯往淹水的城市
下降時，你有種不祥的
預感。電梯門一開，
感覺變得更糟。

column2:
[title32]BLUB BLUB BLUB
It looks like that time bomb has just
pulled the plug on your wretched little
life.
column3:
[title32]咕嘟咕嘟咕嘟
看來那顆定時炸彈，
已經把你這條可悲的
小命收拾掉了。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
This is a video monitor.  You surmise that
the buttons on the bottom of it select various
camera views.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
這是一台監視螢幕。
你猜下方的按鈕是用來
切換不同的攝影機畫面。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nThis is a text monitor.  It is probably\ntied to a computer somewhere.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n這是一台文字螢幕，\n大概連接著某處的電腦。

column2: [title18][sentence]\nThe desk is cluttered with loads of\nunimportant objects.
column3: [title18][sentence]\n桌上堆滿了一堆\n無關緊要的東西。
